title: MEDIA ALERT: Equinix to Speak at Upcoming Investor Conferences
summary: REDWOOD CITY, Calif., Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Equinix, Inc. (Nasdaq: EQIX), the world's digital infrastructure company®, today…...
body_markdown:
REDWOOD CITY, Calif.


, Sept. 4, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[Equinix, Inc.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4767327-1&h=809954617&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.equinix.com%2F&a=Equinix%2C+Inc.) (Nasdaq: EQIX), the world's digital infrastructure company®, today announced that its executives will attend three upcoming investor conferences:


- **Barclays 24** **th** **Annual Global Financial Services Conference** on Monday, September 14. Arquelle Shaw, President, Americas, will present at 10:30 a.m. ET.


- **Bank of America Global Real Estate Conference** on Tuesday, September 15. Stuart Thompson, Senior Vice President, Global Real Estate, will present at 3:00 p.m. ET.


- **RBC Capital Markets Global Communications Infrastructure Conference** on Tuesday, September 29. Olivier Leonetti, Chief Financial Officer, will present at 2:00 p.m. CT.


The presentations will be made available via webcast on the Investor Relations section of the Equinix website at[www.equinix.com/investors](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4767327-1&h=1941772487&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.equinix.com%2Finvestors&a=www.equinix.com%2Finvestors) .
